{"id":1787547274,"question_id":2324,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1759257315,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"147 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1787547274/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Triangular Sum of an Array","memory":"144.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int triangularSum(vector<int>& nums) {\n\n        while(nums.size() != 1)\n        {\n            vector<int>temp(nums.size()-1);\n\n            for(int i=0 ; i<nums.size(); i++)\n            {\n                if(i+1 < nums.size())\n                {\n                    temp[i] = (nums[i] + nums[i+1]) % 10;\n                }\n            }\n            nums = temp;\n        }\n    return nums[0];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-triangular-sum-of-an-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":857}
